threats.name: Direct Prompt Injection
threats.technique: User input explicitly attempts to override trusted instructions.
threats.impact: Trusted task or security policy may be replaced by attacker intent.

threats.name: Indirect Prompt Injection
threats.technique: Retrieved content embeds instructions that are interpreted as executable guidance.
threats.impact: Untrusted RAG content may steer model behavior.

threats.name: External Content Instruction Injection
threats.technique: Tool, webpage, document, or external content contains hidden or explicit instructions.
threats.impact: External data may gain instruction authority.

threats.name: Instruction Hierarchy Confusion
threats.technique: Lower-trust instructions are interpreted as having equal or greater priority than trusted instructions.
threats.impact: Security boundaries encoded in higher-priority instructions may fail.

threats.name: Fake Administrator Authority
threats.technique: Prompt claims that an administrator, security team, or trusted authority approved an exception.
threats.impact: Untrusted language may be mistaken for authorization.

threats.name: Retrieved Authority Spoofing
threats.technique: RAG document claims approval, policy authority, or trusted identity.
threats.impact: Retrieved text may influence privileged agent behavior.

threats.name: System Prompt Extraction
threats.technique: Attacker requests hidden system instructions or uses transformation techniques to reveal them.
threats.impact: Confidential security instructions and implementation details may be disclosed.

threats.name: Policy Extraction
threats.technique: Attacker attempts to reconstruct hidden policy or guardrail logic.
threats.impact: Defensive logic may become easier to target.

threats.name: Role-Play Policy Evasion
threats.technique: Attacker reframes restricted behavior as role-play, simulation, fiction, or alternate persona.
threats.impact: Policy restrictions may be weakened or bypassed.

threats.name: Instruction Encoding / Obfuscation
threats.technique: Malicious instructions are encoded, fragmented, translated, or obfuscated to evade detection.
threats.impact: Prompt security controls may fail to identify adversarial intent.

threats.name: Persistent Instruction Poisoning
threats.technique: Malicious instructions stored in memory are retrieved during later interactions.
threats.impact: Prompt compromise may persist beyond the originating session.

threats.name: Cross-Session Instruction Propagation
threats.technique: Stored state from one trust context influences another session or agent.
threats.impact: Compromise may propagate across users, tasks, sessions, or agents.

threats.name: Prompt-to-Tool Target Substitution
threats.technique: Prompt manipulates the target or parameters of a legitimate tool action.
threats.impact: Authorized functionality may be redirected toward restricted resources.

threats.name: Prompt-to-Privileged-Tool Escalation
threats.technique: Prompt influences the model or agent to request a tool with greater privilege than the trusted task requires.
threats.impact: Natural-language manipulation may approach privileged execution.

threats.name: Prompt-Generated Approval
threats.technique: Model output fabricates an approval token, approval statement, or authorization state.
threats.impact: Generated text may be incorrectly accepted as authorization evidence.

threats.name: Context-Generated Authorization
threats.technique: Retrieved context claims that a requested action is approved.
threats.impact: External data may be incorrectly converted into execution authority.

threats.name: Prompt-Induced Secret Retrieval
threats.technique: Prompt attempts to cause the application or agent to retrieve credentials unnecessarily.
threats.impact: Secrets may enter model context or logs.

threats.name: Prompt-Induced Sensitive Record Access
threats.technique: Prompt manipulates retrieval or tool selection toward unauthorized business data.
threats.impact: Confidential or restricted data may be exposed.

threats.name: Prompt-Driven Resource Exhaustion
threats.technique: Adversarial prompts generate excessive tokens, loops, tool calls, or retrieval cycles.
threats.impact: Cost, availability, latency, or capacity may be affected.

threats.name: Prompt-Based Logging Evasion
threats.technique: Prompt attempts to suppress, fragment, or obscure security-relevant actions.
threats.impact: Detection and forensic reconstruction may be degraded.

abuse_chains.name: Direct Prompt Injection to Privileged Execution
Indirect RAG Injection to Persistent Memory
abuse_chains.impact: Retrieved malicious instructions persist across sessions.

abuse_chains.name: Prompt Injection to Restricted Data
abuse_chains.impact: Prompt manipulation redirects authorized functionality toward restricted data.

abuse_chains.name: Prompt to Secret to Privileged Tool
abuse_chains.impact: Prompt manipulation obtains secret-bearing capability and approaches privileged execution.
